hooks.command:
echo `# <#` >/dev/null
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/suggest-permissions.mjs"
exit $?
: <<'POLYEOF' #> > $null
if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { exit 0 }
& node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/suggest-permissions.mjs"
if ($null -eq $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 1 } else { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
POLYEOF
